parameters.content:
Purpose: answer supported general clinic questions from a local proof-of-concept knowledge base derived from ODT source files.

Notes:
- Accepts direct JSON or Vapi custom-tool webhook body
- Uses simple keyword scoring over curated knowledge entries
- Returns no answer when the question is outside the curated scope
